profile.tech_transfer: Caltech Office of Technology Transfer and Corporate Partnerships (OTTCP)
profile.summary: Caltech is a small, invention-heavy institute where several companies that defined whole tool categories got their start, among them automated DNA sequencing (Applied Biosystems) and microfluidics (Fluidigm), along with protein-design firms such as Xencor. Directed evolution, nanoparticle delivery, AAV capsid engineering and microbiome work from its labs continue to spin out gene-therapy, synbio and therapeutics companies, now with seed money from the institute itself.
programs: Caltech Seed fund (with Wilson Hill Ventures)
Timothy D. Ryan Summer Entrepreneurship Program

labs.known_for: Directed evolution of enzymes; Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2018
Cyclodextrin polymer nanoparticles for drug and siRNA delivery
Engineered AAV capsids for brain-wide gene delivery
Gut microbiome–brain axis; B. fragilis PSA
Computational protein design; Fc and antibody engineering
Ubiquitin-proteasome biology; co-conceived PROTACs with Craig Crews

spinouts.name: Applied Biosystems
spinouts.product: Automated DNA sequencers and synthesizers built on Caltech-licensed technology
spinouts.outcome: merged with Invitrogen 2008 to form Life Technologies (acquired by Thermo Fisher 2014)

spinouts.name: Fluidigm (now Standard BioTools)
spinouts.product: Integrated microfluidic chips for genomics and single-cell analysis
spinouts.outcome: IPO 2011 (NASDAQ: FLDM); renamed Standard BioTools (NASDAQ: LAB) 2022

spinouts.name: Helicos BioSciences
spinouts.product: First commercial single-molecule DNA sequencer, using Caltech-licensed patents

spinouts.name: Xencor
spinouts.product: XmAb engineered Fc/bispecific antibody platform; discovered tafasitamab

spinouts.name: Protabit
spinouts.product: Computational protein design software and services

spinouts.name: Calimmune
spinouts.product: Ex vivo hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (CAL-H for sickle cell)
spinouts.outcome: acquired by CSL Behring 2017 for $91M upfront (plus milestones)

spinouts.name: Immune Design
spinouts.product: GLAAS and ZVex platforms that generate antigen-specific killer T cells

spinouts.name: Insert Therapeutics

spinouts.name: Calando Pharmaceuticals
spinouts.product: Targeted polymer nanoparticles delivering siRNA to tumors

spinouts.name: Cerulean Pharma

spinouts.name: Capsida Biotherapeutics

spinouts.name: Axial Biotherapeutics

spinouts.name: Symbiotix Biotherapies
